nosotros.title: About us
nosotros.subtitle: Technology, verified products and personalized service — from Costa Rica.
nosotros.founderBio1: HotClick is a venture focused on buying, validating and selling outlet and high-demand products at accessible prices. We verify every product before listing it, and through our
nosotros.founderBio1End: we source specific items: send us a photo or description and we'll find it through our supplier network.
nosotros.founderBio2End: at Fidelitas. We already have a functional web app in pre-launch stage, with plans to expand into dropshipping and strategic alliances with other entrepreneurs.
nosotros.val1Desc: We review and validate every item before offering it. You know exactly what you'll receive — no surprises.
nosotros.val2Desc: Looking for something specific? Send us a photo or description and we'll source it. Your request, our mission.
nosotros.val3Desc: We built our own web app so you can shop easily and securely from any device — mobile or desktop.
nosotros.shippingDesc: If you need something faster, choose
nosotros.ctaSub: A digital ecosystem connecting customers, suppliers and entrepreneurs. Any questions, reach out.

informacion.title: Information
informacion.heroSub: How to buy, what product conditions mean, and answers to your most frequent questions.
informacion.howToBuySub: Step by step, simple and straightforward
informacion.step1Desc: Go to the Products section and use category, condition, and availability filters to find exactly what you're looking for. You can sort by price or name.
informacion.step2Desc: Click on any product to see its full description, condition, price, and stock availability. Make sure it's exactly what you need.
informacion.step3Desc: Select the products you want and add them to your order. You can adjust quantities before you pay.
informacion.step4Desc: Enter your details, choose delivery or pickup, and pay at checkout. We confirm the order.
informacion.step5Desc: The order number stays on screen. We send tracking by email.
informacion.step6Desc: We ship via Correos de Costa Rica nationwide, or you can arrange pickup in the GAM. We'll send you the tracking number.
informacion.conditionsSub: All our products are verified before being listed
informacion.cond1Desc: Unused product in its original packaging with all accessories. Same condition as buying in a regular store.
informacion.cond2Desc: Product barely used or returned in excellent condition. May not have original packaging but works perfectly.
informacion.cond2p2: Minimal or no signs of use
informacion.cond2p3: May be missing packaging or a minor accessory
informacion.cond3Desc: Product with visible normal use. We verified it works correctly. Ideal if you want an accessible price and don't mind minor cosmetic details.
informacion.cond3p2: May have scratches or normal wear marks
informacion.shippingSectionSub: You choose the method at checkout
informacion.correosP1: Delivery to nearest Correos branch or home
informacion.correosP2: 2 to 4 business days depending on zone
informacion.uberP1: 30 min to 2 hours to your door
informacion.uberP2: Available within the Greater Metropolitan Area
informacion.uberP4: You choose it under details and payment. Prepaid required.
informacion.uberNote: Express shipping is not arranged via WhatsApp. It is a checkout option, with prepaid required.
informacion.reserveDesc: If you request photos or to see the product, we give you 1 hour to decide. To buy it, add it to your order and pay under details and payment. WhatsApp does not hold the item as a purchase.
informacion.reservePoint1: You can request photos or video of the product via WhatsApp before confirming
informacion.reservePoint2: In the GAM you can arrange to see it in person
informacion.warrantySub: Defect protection (40 days) and withdrawal right (7 business days)
informacion.warrantyBannerTitle: Product warranty: up to 40 days for defects
informacion.warrantyBannerDesc: Warranty covers functionality failures or manufacturing defects for up to 40 days from receipt. Separately, the withdrawal / return right is 7 business days under Law 7472; HotClick coordinates with the seller.
informacion.returnStep1Desc: From My orders or hotclick.cr@gmail.com, within 40 days for warranty (or 7 business days for withdrawal). WhatsApp is for questions.
informacion.returnStep2Desc: Attach photos or a short video showing the problem. This helps us evaluate the case faster.
informacion.returnStep3Desc: Depending on the case: we coordinate a return, product exchange, or refund. We always look for the best solution.
informacion.warrantyNote: Note: The 40-day warranty covers functionality failures. The withdrawal right (7 business days) applies even without a defect, under Law 7472. HotClick coordinates with the seller. Warranty does not cover misuse, drops, liquids, or modifications.
informacion.faq1q: What shipping options do you have?
informacion.faq1a: At checkout you choose: Correos de Costa Rica (nationwide), express shipping in the GAM (30 min to 2 hours), your courier, or store pickup if the product allows it. WhatsApp is for questions, not for arranging shipping.
informacion.faq2q: How much does express shipping cost?
informacion.faq2a: ₡5,000 within the GAM, prepaid. You choose it under details and payment when you complete the order.
informacion.faq3q: What payment methods do you accept?
informacion.faq3a: You pay at checkout: card, SINPE Móvil, bank transfer, or cash at pickup, depending on the order. WhatsApp is for questions, not for completing payment.
informacion.faq4q: Can I see the product before buying?
informacion.faq4a: Yes. You can request photos or video via WhatsApp before confirming. For clients in the GAM we can also arrange an in-person viewing. Just ask us.
informacion.faq5q: Is a product held via WhatsApp?
informacion.faq5a: WhatsApp is for questions. If you ask for photos or to see it, we give you 1 hour of courtesy. Stock is confirmed when you complete the order under details and payment.
informacion.faq6q: How many days of warranty do products have?
informacion.faq6a: All our products have a 40-day functionality warranty. If it stops working in that period, report it from My orders or hotclick.cr@gmail.com. We look for repair, exchange, or refund as appropriate.
informacion.faq7q: How do I apply the warranty?
informacion.faq7a: From My orders or hotclick.cr@gmail.com, within 40 days, describe the problem and attach a photo or video. WhatsApp is for questions. We'll guide the return or exchange.
informacion.faq8q: How do I know if a product is available?
informacion.faq8a: Stock is shown in real time in the catalog. If it shows 'In stock' or the quantity available, the product is ready to ship. If 'Out of stock', contact us to find out when it returns.
informacion.faq9q: How can I track my order via Correos CR?
informacion.faq9a: Once shipped, we send the tracking number by email. You can use it at correos.go.cr and see the status in My orders.
informacion.ctaSub: Add to your order and pay under details and payment. WhatsApp is for questions.
